description: Search and list SEC filings with filtering by company (CIK), form type, and date range. Returns paginated results with filing metadata including form type, filing date, company name, and accession number. Use this to find filings before reading their content with get_filing_document or get_filing_exhibits.

ciks.description: Comma-separated CIK numbers to filter by (e.g., "0000320193,0001018724")

name: search_sec_filings
title: Search SEC Filings
